name: Falfindel Waywarder
summary: At Thalanaar, Falfindel Waywarder keeps watch over the border between Feralas and Thousand Needles. The night elf druid works to heal corrupted lands and guard Kalimdor’s southern wilderness. Travelers from Stonetalon or the Barrens often seek his aid to restore balance to the wild.

sections.title: Watch at the Southern Border
sections.body: Falfindel Waywarder stands at Thalanaar, the night elf outpost on the edge of Feralas. The outpost marks the passage from forest to mesas and salt plains. Travelers who have crossed far across the continent greet him there. From this post, he watches for local threats and dangers to lands across Kalimdor.

sections.title: Healing the Charred Vale
sections.body: Falfindel Waywarder watches from the south, but the ruin of the Charred Vale in Stonetalon Mountains weighs on him. Dark sorcery and fire scarred that wilderness. When adventurers bring aid for its recovery, he calls on the forest spirits. Falfindel summons swarms of wisps and sends them north to mend the scorched earth.

sections.title: Eyes on the Quilboar and the Wastes
sections.body: Falfindel Waywarder also watches the region around Thalanaar, including the quilboar dens of Razorfen Kraul. He studies recovered journals and gathers word of quilboar leaders. His watch helps the Alliance understand the dangers threatening the passes between Feralas and the central deserts.

faq.answer: Falfindel Waywarder is stationed at Thalanaar, the night elf outpost on the border between Feralas and Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What is Falfindel's role at Thalanaar?
faq.answer: Falfindel Waywarder watches regional threats, including the quilboar of Razorfen Kraul, and coordinates efforts to restore ruined lands such as the Charred Vale.

faq.q: How does Falfindel help the Charred Vale?
faq.answer: When adventurers bring aid for the Charred Vale, Falfindel Waywarder summons forest wisps and sends them north to Stonetalon to heal the blighted land.

faq.q: Why is Falfindel interested in Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Falfindel Waywarder studies the quilboar threat at Razorfen Kraul. He examines items such as Lonebrow's journal to follow the influence of leaders like the Crone of the Kraul.

faq.q: Is Falfindel aligned with the Alliance or neutral?
faq.answer: Falfindel Waywarder is a night elf druid allied with Darnassus and the Alliance. Horde travelers will find Thalanaar hostile.

faq.q: What does Falfindel say to travelers?
faq.answer: Falfindel Waywarder greets friendly visitors warmly and notes their long journey: “You look as though you have traveled from afar.”

angles.text: As a night elf, you see Falfindel Waywarder keep watch on Kalimdor’s frontiers, mend nature’s scars, and guard against dangers in the wild.
As a druid, you share Falfindel Waywarder’s sacred work of restoration as he sends forest spirits and wisps to heal Stonetalon’s scorched soil.
As an Alliance traveler making the long trek south from the Barrens or Stonetalon, you can find a welcome at Thalanaar with Falfindel Waywarder and its watch.
